description.en: Edit DOCX, XLSX and PPTX in DSH and save to the original file. Prepares about 140 MB of shared read-only core resources for the three editors, fonts and conversion; other resources use the member cache. The plugin and SDK contain AGPL-3.0 software; review upstream license terms before use.
description.zh-CN: 在DSH中编辑DOCX、XLSX和PPTX并保存回原文件。预备约140MB的三种编辑器核心资源、字体和转换器，共享层只读；其他资源回退成员缓存。插件和SDK包含AGPL-3.0软件，使用前请阅读上游许可条款。
